messages:
liam: FYI incoming from Volta procurement 
They uploaded a SIG/CAIQ and asked whether we can guarantee EU-only storage for tenant data + support customer-managed keys. Need security intake. Deadline: next Tue EOD.
sec_bot: Intake created: INT-VOLTA-2026-09 
Priority: high (customer requests EU residency + CMK). Assigned to security queue. SLA target: 48h.
nina: Thanks @liam. Can you confirm if the POC will touch embeddings or only chat responses? That affects storage paths. Also attach the SIG file (if not already).
liam: Attached both CAIQ and SIG spreadsheet to the portal. POC will test embeddings + chat reranking. Volta asked about per-tenant EU partitioning (some tenants global, some EU-only).
carl: Quick notes: 1) We can run dedicated EU-hosted deployment for EU tenants. 2) CMK support: AWS KMS and GCP KMS supported; cross-account access needs an IAM role and policy. 3) Embeddings store can be SSE-KMS in EU bucket.
tess: Legal check: if they want CMK where key is in their account, we need key policy review and possible addendum. Also check export controls / data transfer clauses.
oliver: I'll own the infra pattern for the POC. Minimal infra: small dedicated pool in eu-west-1, private subnets, S3 bucket with SSE-KMS, and separate tenant DB schema.
wanda: Security lead 
I'm picking up INT-VOLTA-2026-09. I'll do CAIQ top-10 within 24h and confirm KMS pattern. Can we get SOC2 and pen test artifacts?
liam: Uploaded SOC2 redacted and latest pen test to the intake portal. They were in the files link.
nina: Two follow-ups: 1) Does Redwood support bring-your-own-key for embeddings indexing? 2) If we do EU-only, is there a pricing uplift estimate? Sales needs a ballpark to share.
carl: BYOK for embeddings: yes, via SSE-KMS for object store and customer CMK if they supply. Note: vector DB caching may still use ephemeral keys; we need to mark that in the CAIQ.
tess: Pricing: for EU-dedicated there's a regional surcharge + cross-region replication costs if they opt for global tenants. I'll ask finance for a quick delta and post back.
wanda: Triage update: answered CAIQ high-risk items (auth, data segregation, key management). Documented mitigation for cross-tenant leakage: strict tenant isolation + network ACLs + separate service accounts. Uploaded to intake.
oliver: Provisioned POC environment: eu-west-1 ded pool (2xA10G), KMS role created, example IAM snippet in intake:
```
{  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    { "Effect": "Allow", "Action": ["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"], "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:999999999999:key/volta-cmk" }
  ]
}
```
liam: Volta asked if we can do key-holder attestation (proof keys are in their AWS account). Is that something we can provide?
wanda: We can provide deployment architecture + sampled key policy template and confirm cross-account role. We do not export keys. Attestation: we can provide screenshots of KMS key ARN and role usage, along with logging evidence.
tess: Finance back-of-envelope: EU-only dedicated = +18% list price vs default hosted. Include operational fee if customer wants full Private (on-prem).
liam: Customer response: If CMK is fully in their account and we can show logs of key usage, they will greenlight POC. They want deliverables by Tuesday morning.
wanda: Action list: 1) Finalize CMK cross-account guide (owner: carl). 2) Produce 1-page security summary for procurement (owner: wanda). 3) Confirm price delta (owner: tess). 4) Keep INT-VOLTA-2026-09 open until confirmation.
sec_bot: INT-VOLTA-2026-09 status: triage -> in_progress at 1715103000 by wanda
liam: Thanks team. If we can get the one-pager + CMK guide by Monday EOD, I'm comfortable pushing this through procurement.
wanda: Uploaded 1-pager + CAIQ answers. Marking ready for review.
sec_bot: INT-VOLTA-2026-09 status: in_progress -> resolved_by_wanda at 1715105400
liam: Closing loop 
Volta confirmed POC start. Will open a follow-up thread for post-POC production contract items. Cheers.
